# Committed originals and wave commit

## 1. Committed originals at home (before the first wave)

Run the scoped status check:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/app" status --porcelain -- "doc/plans/cache.md" "doc/specs/cache.md"
```

The output is nonempty, so commit the plan and spec. The message comes from the held spec H1, with no spec read in the parent. The overrides' `refs:` convention puts the held ticket in the body as `Refs #241`, not in the subject.

```bash
git -C "/workspace/app" add -- "doc/plans/cache.md" "doc/specs/cache.md"
git -C "/workspace/app" commit -F - -- "doc/plans/cache.md" "doc/specs/cache.md" <<'MSG'
Add the implementation plan for cache profile lookups

Refs #241
MSG
```

The pathspec limits this commit to the plan and spec. The unrelated staged `src/config.mjs` is not committed and stays in the index untouched. Both commands succeed, so dispatch may proceed.

## 2. Wave commit (isolated wave: gate green, latest verdict SHIP)

The subject is one sentence built from the two accepted task headings. The ticket again goes in the body per `refs:`.

```bash
WAVE_BASE_SHA=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
git -C "/workspace/app" reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" && \
git -C "/workspace/app" add -A && \
git -C "/workspace/app" commit -F - <<'MSG'
Cache profile lookups and invalidate stale cache entries

Refs #241
MSG
```

## 3. Tracker updates (only after the commit succeeds)

Mark both of the wave's task indices `complete` together, in increasing index order:

```ts
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: <index of "Cache profile lookups">, status: "complete" })
plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: <index of "Invalidate stale profile cache">, status: "complete" })
```

The scenario gives no manifest `orchestrator` instruction for this wave, so nothing else runs at the completed-wave boundary.
